sol: p-12927 (Peter Delius) anchors 0000-0002-1693-5084, whose public record names Linell Chewins and claims the 2024 Turning South African History Upside Down article. Its current deposit lists Peter Delius and Linell Chewins as separate authors, assigning that iD only to Chewins.

The iD anchored to p-277966, 0000-0002-9421-8566, publicly names Manfred A. Jeusfeld, Skövde professor from 2013 and Passau doctorate 1992; Wrisley’s other iD records NYU Abu Dhabi from 2017. Both sampled 2023–2024 works print David Joseph Wrisley but deposit Jeusfeld’s iD, including NYU Abu Dhabi affiliation in 2024.

The two graph anchors are swapped: the iD on Lacueva Muñoz’s key publicly identifies José Saldaña Fernández, and the iD on Saldaña Fernández’s key identifies Jaime J. Lacueva Muñoz. Two 2020–2021 co-authored deposits consistently give Lacueva 0000-0003-3426-5034 and Saldaña 0000-0002-2466-4501.

This is the reciprocal shared-iD row for h-114: Lacueva’s graph key anchors the public José Saldaña Fernández record, and Saldaña’s key anchors the public Jaime J. Lacueva Muñoz record. Both 2020–2021 joint deposits assign the identifiers consistently to the correct printed authors.

The 2023 Trump e Bolsonaro article prints Roberto Moll Neto and Rafael Rossotto Ioris separately but gives both Steven Forti’s iD; that iD is anchored on the Roberto-labelled key. The public records separately identify Forti and Ioris, including Ioris’s Denver employment from 2009.
